basics.name: Gourab Dutta
basics.label: Robotics & IoT Architect | Embedded Systems & Computer Vision
basics.summary: Electronics and Communication Engineering student who builds embedded, IoT and computer-vision systems end to end: firmware, sensing, wireless links and the software around them. Multiple-time hackathon winner with hands-on hardware experience since Class 10.

education.degree: B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering

highlights: Engineering embedded systems, firmware integration, and hardware testing for IoT solutions.
Built Cratus (combat robot), Sonar Radar, Spectrum Analyzer, Autopilot dashboard and FPV Racer.
Collaborated on robotics hardware architecture, kinematic simulations, and high-frequency sensor telemetry.
Conducted workshops on microcontroller programming, PCB fabrication, and autonomous drone flight.

projects.name: Smart Medicine Box
highlights: Built an ESP32 medicine box around a five-state finite state machine with NTP time synchronization, HC-SR04 distance sensing, servo actuation and TTP223 touch input.
Wrote a Node.js WebSocket dashboard for real-time monitoring and event logging of the device.

projects.name: Webcam Heart-Rate Measurement (rPPG) Validated Against ECG
highlights: Implemented POS, CHROM and green-channel rPPG on MediaPipe FaceMesh multi-region input, with zero-phase Butterworth filtering (0.75 to 2.8 Hz), harmonic disambiguation and slew-rate limiting.
Built an AD8232 and ESP32 ECG reference sampling at 250 Hz, plus an analysis pipeline (MAE, RMSE, Bland-Altman, Wilcoxon) across four lighting, distance and motion conditions.

projects.name: Orbit Eye, Standalone GPS Smartwatch
highlights: Wrote firmware for NMEA parsing, a 240x240 SPI display, a four-screen non-blocking UI state machine and a great-circle bearing compass.
Integrated Google Places with automatic OpenStreetMap Overpass fallback to list the five nearest venues within 3 km; published prebuilt binaries and a browser-based Web Serial flasher.

projects.name: Four-Legged Crawler Robot
highlights: Built a 12-servo quadruped (three joints per leg) with coordinate-based leg control, timer-driven servo updates and gait routines for walking, turning, sitting and waving.
Included a servo-calibration utility and 3D-printable mechanical parts.

projects.name: Air-Dimmer, Gesture-Controlled Lighting
highlights: Mapped thumb-to-index finger distance from hand tracking to 0 to 255 PWM brightness, sent to an ESP32 over Wi-Fi sockets.

projects.name: ASTRA, Autonomous Subsurface Tracking & Rescue Architecture (Team Circuit Bird)
highlights: Designing a multi-legged disaster-rescue robot that detects trapped victims, builds live 3D maps and analyses acoustic and thermal signals.
Combining OpenCV, MediaPipe and YOLOv8 perception with an MPU9250 IMU and a Streamlit and MongoDB dashboard.

projects.name: Gesture-Control Projects
highlights: Built a hand-gesture steering wheel for browser racing games, a two-hand neon Cat's Cradle animation in the browser, and a Fruit Ninja-style slicing game.

projects.name: Check Mate
highlights: Personal repository for check-mate
Autonomous open-source implementation with continuous GitHub telemetry.

projects.name: Gesture Puzzle Game
highlights: An interactive, touchless computer vision puzzle game using Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe AI hand-tracking.
Autonomous open-source implementation with continuous GitHub telemetry.

projects.name: Zyro Elder Care
highlights: Zyro Elder Care is an AI-powered elderly healthcare system with real-time health monitoring, medicine reminders, SOS alerts, and AI medical report analysis for safer senior care.
Autonomous open-source implementation with continuous GitHub telemetry.
